clauses.clause: [+2]: Ugin deals 3 damage to any target.
clauses.evidence: activate [0] at each of the nine targets: loyalty 7 -> 9 every time; 3 damage kills you_bear, opp_flier, opp_tapped and opp_bear and marks the 4/4s; Ugin herself goes 9 -> 6; either player 20 -> 17. The slot offers creatures, Ugin and both players.

clauses.clause: [-X]: Exile each permanent with mana value X or less that's one or more colors.
clauses.evidence: ask x offers 0..7; X=0 and X=1 exile nothing, X=2 exiles the mana-value-2 creatures of both sides (you_bear, opp_flier, opp_bear), X=3 adds opp_tapped, X=5 the two 4/4s; the colorless relic and charm stay even at X=7; loyalty falls by X, and at X=7 Ugin dies to the state-based action while the exile still happens. K02_4 and K02_5 add multicolored, colorless artifact and land, and a mana-value-0 token at X=0.

clauses.clause: [-10]: You gain 7 life, draw seven cards, then put up to seven permanent cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: ability [2] is 'not activatable from battlefield: cost:loyalty:7<10' (Ugin starts at 7), so it never resolves in the trace. Packs: K02_1 (gain 7, draw 7 before the pick, pick five and stop), K02_2 (the cap of seven picks), K02_3 (only the controller's permanent cards in hand are offered).
